thread:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — recurring page storms last week. We need owners for the action items (dedupe, thresholds, paging policy). Please call dibs and add ETA.
lee: I can take dedupe tuning. Will prototype a 60s dedupe window and try to reduce duplicates from the same upstream source. ETA 10 business days. :+1:
sam: I'll own threshold tuning and metric analysis. Doing a noise sweep tomorrow to find the 95th percentile baselines. ETA 1 week.
oncall-bot: Incident 2024-11-12: page-storm-high-errors — 432 pages in 6h. Link: https://redwood.incidents/2024-11-12-psh (summary attached).
alex: I can handle paging policy (who gets paged vs routed to ops-runbook). Will draft a policy doc and a canary rollout plan. ETA 2 weeks.
maya: Great — update the tracker sheet and add links to any PRs/runbooks: https://docs.redwood/pmt/action-tracker. We'll convert these into JIRA tasks if needed.
lee: quick config snippet I'm testing locally:
```yaml
alert: downstream-errors
for: 2m
dedupe_window: 60s
severity: page
```
sam: For the metric query I'm using to find noisy signals:
```
sum by(alertname) (rate(errors_total[5m]))
```
This helps spot alerts that spike frequently.
alex: One question — do we want a soft-page (notify channel) vs hard-page (pager) split by severity? I can include that decision matrix in my doc.
maya: Yes, include soft/hard split and a fallback (auto-escalation) after 15m. Also add a rollback plan for the canary.
lee: putting PR up for dedupe rule test tomorrow morning, will ping here when ready.
sam: I'll attach the baseline graphs to the tracker after tomorrow's sweep.
oncall-bot: Reminder: next oncall rotation starts 2024-11-19.
maya: Let's reconvene in the weekly oncall sync — add this to agenda. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
alex: ack, adding agenda item and calendar invite.
lee: ack.
sam: ack.
